reconciliation.text: Every substantive source paragraph retained and adapted into English.
reconciliation.comments: The complete post, the exact English quotation, its Russian version and letter attribution are retained. The sole comment block is included in Notes, with both its portrait and complete two-year mortality chart, the 1858 book title and all three colour meanings. All three selected source illustrations are included in order.
reconciliation.digest: The approved digest was checked against the complete source, including all substantive comments, and condensed into one or two finished sentences.

manual_changes: Source title moved to shared heading; source hashtags moved to metadata.
External links placed on descriptive words; English adaptation prepared from the complete source.

questions.question: Для цитаты «Whenever I am infuriated…» уточнить архивный шифр либо страницу издания письма Сидни Герберту от 19 августа 1857 года. В исходнике приведены дата и адресат, но нет точного указателя; они сохранены в RU/EN. Членство 1858 года проверено по странице самого RSS https://rss.org.uk/news-publication/news-publications/2020/general-news/nightingale-2020-the-bicentenary-our-first-female/ и не является открытым вопросом.
questions.resolution: Фраза проверена по транскрипции письма Сидни Герберту в UKWILT, с. 126, Wiltshire County Record Office 2057/F4/66. Хронология Collected Works, с. 257–258, датирует письмо 19 августа 1857 года. В обеих версиях добавлена ссылка на транскрипцию с архивным шифром.
